jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Clear
jobs.description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem---homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents---onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Settlement Agencies depend on Qualia Clear to help improve the speed and quality of a real estate closing. They also rely on Qualia Clear to do chunks of work for them, end-to-end. Qualia Clear's curative agents do this work in production today, on real transactions.

As Product Manager for Curative, you will own this agent portfolio end to end — what the agents do next, how precisely they're specified, and whether customers actually use them. If you've built AI agents and want to put them to work at national scale, this is a good fit.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the curative agent portfolio end to end: roadmap, scoping, release, adoption, and iteration

- Scope agents with deep, precise requirements for AI systems working real title workflows across all 50 states

- Build rapid prototypes to pressure-test ideas before committing engineering time

- Partner with Engineering and Design to break ambitious goals into small, shippable milestones that deliver value fast

- Write tight, plain-language PRDs that frame the problem, success criteria, and context

- Analyze deployment and utilization data rigorously; use it to sharpen priorities every release

- Collect and analyze metrics on everything you ship — how well it works and how much it's used

- Monitor COGs per agent run and drive them down without sacrificing accuracy

- Report to executives on ideas, roadmap, product adoption, and agent performance

- Work with GTM, CS, and customers directly to drive adoption of everything you ship

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager building exceptional software products

- Experience building AI agents — professionally or personally. Come ready to demo one

- Fluent with AI tooling (Claude Code or equivalent) as a daily working method, not a curiosity

- You get what we're trying to do — how the models work, what AI changes for an industry like this — and you can get up to speed on title quickly

- Hungry and proactive: you find the work, you don't wait for it

- Enterprise SaaS or ERP product experience; systems thinker who builds into complex, interconnected products

- Analytical and metrics-driven, with a track record of defining success, instrumenting it, and acting on it

- Exceptional written communication — tight, plain, and defensible

- Knowledge of real estate, title, or escrow industries is a plus

While this role is based in Austin, Texas, we're open to exploring remote possibilities for qualified candidates. We have other physical office locations in San Francisco, California, and Concord, New Hampshire.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems---and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Qualia is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, or veteran status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information as described in our Employee Data Privacy Notice .

- Produce compelling value propositions and messaging that differentiate our products in the market and resonate with target audiences

- Partner with sales teams to develop effective tools, training, and content that empower them to communicate product value to prospects and customers. Create and deliver presentations, sales collateral, and case studies that show customer success

- A naturally analytical, critical thinker who digs into the "why" behind strategy and positioning

- Genuinely curious and customer-centric, with a track record of grounding messaging in real customer pain points

- Self-driven and outcome-oriented: someone who holds their own work to a high bar and keeps pushing to improve it

- Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence multiple stakeholders without direct authority

- Experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, with strong organizational and project management skills
